I fixed issue #7 and opened PR #14: https://github.com/acme/notes/pull/14. It isn't ready to merge yet, because `fetchSession` doesn't exist anywhere in the repo. I haven't run or tested the change.

- **Fix:** `refresh()` in `src/auth.js` now returns `fetchSession()` when the session has expired. Before, it called itself forever.
- **Problem:** The issue says to call `fetchSession()`, but it isn't defined or imported anywhere. The loop is gone, but an expired session will throw a `ReferenceError` until that function exists. I called it as the issue says and noted the gap in the PR description.
- **Next step:** AGENTS.md says the owner merges every PR himself. I posted a Starbridge card (d_ajdPufDOE7UGFqrQ) asking whether to merge now or hold until `fetchSession` exists. I recommended holding. I'll act on his answer when it arrives.
